amendments.what: liquidation-cluster proxy is non-discriminating on these alts
amendments.detail: smoke day XLMUSDT 2026-09-26: 1457 triggers (floor 10 x 25.1 USD median print, summed reading as declared); XLMUSDT 2026-09-27 tape (mechanics only, no P&L): summed reading 1372 triggers, per-print reading 480 triggers, both keep the 60-min pull on 99.9% of the day. Print sizes are heavy-tailed, so 10 x the median print is a low bar. The declared (summed) proxy is kept unchanged; A2 is effectively a no-new-inventory arm, so A2 - A1 is not an informative test of R-FLOW-2.
amendments.effect: none on the grid, split or tests; reported as a caveat

amendments.what: the BTC-move z fires on a large share of BTC prints
amendments.detail: independent Python check on BTCUSDT 2026-09-27 (first hour, sigma_1h 17 bp from the previous 240 min): share of prints with z > 2 / 3 / 4 = 0.34 / 0.23 / 0.15; per active second 0.11 / 0.06 / 0.03 (Gaussian 0.046 / 0.003 / 0.0001); the Rust replay counted 0.46 / 0.36 / 0.29 of prints on 09-26. Prints cluster in moving seconds and 1 s returns are far from Gaussian, so the registered rule pulls often; kept unchanged.
